items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: And Shelly and all the guys, Don Lamond, whose ever there.

ctx.x: Conte was about 16 when he was with Woody back in the 40s, with Dave Tough was the drummer. No he remembered him well. And then he went back with a bop band. I’ll tell you a little story about Gene Krupa. The kind of a guy he was. Nothing was taken for granted. You know Buddy Rich worked so hard to be the king of the drums after Gene. But Gene Krupa was the king of the drums. He was the most famous drummer of all time. He put everybody where they are now. Nicest guy that ever lived. Buddy DeFranco said that too.…
